acceptance: The Host interrupted both active Kotlin streams after the first recovery-turn assistant chunk and continued the Session while the client was offline.
The recovered authoritative snapshot advanced by 11 sequence values, ended at cursor 93 with hasMore false, and contained the completed terminal projection.
The client replaced follow and Remote Event streams twice across fault recovery and repeated reconnect.
A second reconnect at the same authoritative cut returned cursor 93 and produced a structurally equal projected JSON value, proving duplicate-safe idempotence for the Kotlin lane.
The Host independently compared the native observations with its own Session projection before publishing the result.
knownLimitations: Swift 对应验收仍为 NOT_EXECUTED / SKIPPED_BY_USER。Kotlin E4 不满足双语言退出条件。
